chevron.description: Draws a trailing chevron. Left unset, a row with `href` draws one.

selected.description: Marks the row as the current one with a tint.

href.description: Makes the whole row a link to this address.

rel.description: The link's relationship; `noopener noreferrer` is added for `_blank`.

unsupportedProps.name: action
unsupportedProps.description: A trailing action such as a menu button. It sits in a fixed-width column, so a changing value never moves its click target.

unsupportedProps.name: lead
unsupportedProps.description: A fixed-width column for a time or number, such as "45 min left", drawn before the title. Rows in one list line up.

unsupportedProps.name: leading
unsupportedProps.description: A leading icon, thumbnail, avatar or control, drawn before the text.

unsupportedProps.name: photo
unsupportedProps.description: A trailing photo. It reserves no space when absent.

unsupportedProps.name: subtitle
unsupportedProps.description: A secondary line under the title, in muted text. A status is a small dot plus a word here, never a badge.

unsupportedProps.name: title
unsupportedProps.description: The row's main text. With `href`, it becomes the link and the whole row is its target.

unsupportedProps.name: trailing
unsupportedProps.description: A trailing value, such as a count or a short status. It is right-aligned and never moves the action column.
